gloss: some years ago; a few years back

definitions.gloss: some years ago; a few years back; in previous years
definitions.explanation: An indefinite past time several years before now — more remote than {去年|きょねん} (last year) but typically within recent memory. Has a slightly formal or literary tone.

examples.japanese: {先年|せんねん}{亡|な}くなった{祖父|そふ}を{思|おも}い{出|だ}す。
examples.english: I think of my grandfather, who passed away some years ago.

examples.japanese: {先年|せんねん}の{震災|しんさい}の{被害|ひがい}はまだ{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: The damage from the earthquake disaster a few years back still remains.

examples.japanese: {先年|せんねん}{出版|しゅっぱん}された{彼|かれ}の{著書|ちょしょ}が{再評価|さいひょうか}されている。
examples.english: His book, published a few years ago, is being reevaluated.

notes:
{先|せん} (previous, earlier) + {年|ねん} (year). Used more in writing and formal speech than in casual conversation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {去年|きょねん}: last year — specifically the year before this one
- {一昨年|おととし}: the year before last — exactly two years ago
- {数年前|すうねんまえ}: a few years ago — neutral, common in conversation
- {往年|おうねん}: bygone years, days of yore — more literary, evokes nostalgia

REGISTER: Sounds slightly stiff or written; in casual speech {数年前|すうねんまえ} or 'この{前|まえ}' is more natural.
